s.f: \text{reflect the source in the mirror; reflected ray passes through the image}
s.n: Image in $ax+by+c=0$: $\frac{x-x_1}a=\frac{y-y_1}b=\frac{-2(ax_1+by_1+c)}{a^2+b^2}$. Shortest path via a line: straight line to the image.
